extraction_notes: Target row on p. 2: MMSZ5245B, type code H5: VZ min 14.25 V / nom 15.0 V / max 15.75 V at IZT = 8.5 mA; ZZT = 16 ohm; IR = 0.1 uA max at VR = 11.0 V.

Zener impedance condition is ambiguous in this datasheet: the p. 2 column header reads 'ZZT@IZT=0.25mA', but the 16 ohm value matches the industry-standard ZZT at IZT = 8.5 mA, and 0.25 mA is the conventional knee (ZZK/IZK) test current (Fig. 6 likewise labels its upper curve IZ = 0.25 mA). ZZT is therefore recorded only in these notes, not as a conditioned spec.

Curve digitization method for Fig. 2: page rasterized at 400 dpi; plot frame and gridlines located programmatically; x axis linear 10-45 V, y axis log 0.5-100 mA; the 15 V curve is the 5th curve from the left (labels 11, 12, 13, 14, 15). Estimated uncertainty about +/-0.1 V in VZ (half stroke width) and a few percent in IZ. The curve merges into the 500 mW power envelope above about 22 mA, so points stop at 21.5 mA.
Digitized VZ at IZT = 8.5 mA is about 14.96 V, consistent with the 15.0 V nominal table value.
Capacitance was digitized from Fig. 5 at VZ nom = 15 V: 0 V bias about 30 pF, 1 V bias about 25 pF, 50%-of-VZ-nom bias about 12 pF; the 50% bias value is recorded as the capacitance spec.
VF max 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA appears in the p. 1 Maximum Ratings table; no forward IV curve is provided, so only this single forward point is available.
Thermal/limit context (not schema fields): PD = 500 mW at Ta <= 25 degC derating linearly to 0 at 150 degC (p. 4, Fig. 7); RthJA = 340 K/W (p. 1); Tj and Tstg -55 to +150 degC (p. 1).
reverse_recovery is null: no reverse recovery specification exists for this zener family in the datasheet.
Evidence source: public datasheet only; no vendor SPICE or model packs consulted.
